      How Squeektoshi's garden grows

      Full player guide →
      ⚙️ Wheel snacks

      Grow with every pass of the real wheel, read from SqueekCore on Ethereum. No running, no growing.

      🧱 Block snacks

      Grow with each Squeekchain block the hamster mines, so the chain's difficulty sets their pace.

      💤 Nap snacks

      Grow while Squeektoshi rests and wilt if he runs too much before you pick them.

      🌙 Fresh-run snacks

      Can only be picked right after he has run, so night owls get them.

      🫙 The pantry

      Every harvest goes into his shared pantry. When it fills up, new seeds unlock for everyone.

      🏡 Neighbours

      Water a neighbour's plant once a day: their crop grows bigger and you earn points for helping.
